scope: Functional McKernel OS/apps and Rust/assembly migration only; no security testing.
callback_ABI: void (*)(int event,int value,int result), Rust unsafe extern C fn(CInt,CInt,CInt); CInt=i32
event_predicate: Only PTRACE_CONTROL_LOG_WAKEUP_ENTER=4 produces the gated diagnostic; other events stay silent
argument_order: result: signed int passed to %08x, formatter extracts unsigned int
concrete_domain_witness: data:CLong=-1 is converted to CInt=-1 and logged before ptrace_signal_data_result rejects negative data. The callback itself has no nonnegative result precondition.
blocker: Negative signed int passed as %x unsigned-int vararg lacks a defined signed/unsigned-representable contract. A new unsigned cast would choose new behavior; passing signed i32 directly in a new Rust variadic leaf would retain the mismatch. Neither is implemented or called accepted parity.
debug_descriptor_obligation: dkprintf emits the original static __verbose ddebug identity and gates on nonzero flags. Future reviewed Rust logger must preserve that actual existing descriptor identity/gating; unguarded kprintf would change behavior and registry.
source_only_checks: PASS callback/event/format/type/order/negative-before-validation and debuggate consumer evidence; this PASS establishes the blocker, not port acceptance
proposed_followup: Root/expert chooses explicit signed-hex logging contract for invalid negative input and descriptor-preserving ownership path; no arbitrary cast, weakened oracle or registry rewrite. Then prepare a private leaf after that concrete decision.
compose_with_settid: Separate candidate; no duplicate settid files. Both future leaf modules would require independent additions to parent syscall_policy module list and kernel/CMakeLists dependency list. Rebase their small insertions in Root integration order; do not apply either shared postimage over the other.
